let h:any;const results:any[]=[],attempt=process.env.ATTEMPT??'01';
async function test(name:string,f:()=>Promise<any>){try{const observed=await f();results.push({name,status:'PASS',observed});console.log('PASS',name);}catch(e:any){results.push({name,status:'FAIL',error:e.stack});console.log('FAIL',name,e.message);}await writeFile('audit/h6-003/results-'+attempt+'.json',JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');}
async function snapshot(pattern='^(b03_|b04_|b05_|b06_|b07_|identity_)'){const out:any={};for(const{tablename:t}of await h.observer`select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='crm_private'and tablename~${pattern} order by tablename`)out[t]=(await h.observer.unsafe(`select coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,E'\n'order by to_jsonb(t)::text),'') v from crm_private.${t} t`))[0].v;return out;}
async function denied(run:()=>Promise<any>){const before=await snapshot();await assert.rejects(run);assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),before);}
const scope=(f:any,index=1)=>({kind:'service',id:f.services[index].id});
const nights=async(f:any)=>Array.from(await h.observer`select n.night_id::text id,n.night_date::text date,sum(c.attendees)::int attendees from crm_private.b04_nights n join crm_private.b04_night_occupancies o using(night_id)join crm_private.b04_contributions c using(contribution_id)where c.booking_id=${f.bookingId}::uuid group by n.night_id,n.night_date order by n.night_date`);
function sem(v:any,f:any){const lines=f.content.modalities.flatMap((m:any)=>m.lines);return{services:v.booking.detail.services.map((s:any)=>({id:s.id,serviceRevisionId:s.serviceRevisionId,nature:s.nature,variant:s.variant??null,provider:s.provider??null,place:s.place??null,schedule:s.schedule??null,date:s.date??s.contributions.map((c:any)=>lines.find((l:any)=>l.id===c.lineId)?.date).filter(Boolean).sort()[0]??null,contributions:s.contributions.map((c:any)=>({id:c.id,lineId:c.lineId,modalityId:c.modalityId,quantity:c.quantity,attendees:c.attendees,certainty:c.certainty,date:c.date??lines.find((l:any)=>l.id===c.lineId)?.date??null})),nights:s.nights.map((n:any)=>({id:n.id,date:n.date,contributionIds:n.contributionIds}))})),participants:v.booking.detail.participants,assignments:v.booking.detail.assignments};}
async function ready(options:any={}){const f=await fixture(h,options);await f.run();return f;}
async function confirm(f:any,index=0,quantity='10'){const provider=await h.cat('provider',{name:'SYNTHETIC AUD003 provider'}),c=await confirmationFixture(h,{bookingId:f.bookingId,provider,b:{detail:f.q.detail}}as any,index);const coverage={...c.coverage,date:'2026-11-20',quantity};await c.apply(await c.register({coverage}));await c.apply(await c.evaluate({coverage}));return c;}
async function economic(f:any,variant='eligible'){
 const economyId=id(),unit=await h.cat('unit',{name:'SYNTHETIC auditor own unit',definition:'fixed group'}),form=await h.cat('pricing_form',{name:'SYNTHETIC exact own fixed',definition:'fixed'}),promotion=await h.com('promotion',{policy:'novio_gratis',minimum_attendees:'15',required_lodging:'1',required_activity:'1',required_restaurant:'1',required_tarari_drinks:'2',effect_basis:'honoree_modality_final_person_price'});
 const component=async(label:string,value:string)=>{const rule={id:'SYNTHETIC auditor-'+label,version:'1',mechanism:'fixed',sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC approved audit rule'},proof=await f.proof('own-rule:'+await f.hash(rule),economyId),fact={input:{kind:'materialize',value},sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC independent approved basis',version:'1',vat:'unknown',tax:null};return{id:label,serviceId:f.services[0].id,unitRevisionId:unit.revision,pricingFormRevisionId:form.revision,rule:{...rule,approvalEvidenceId:proof},phases:{expected:fact,confirmed:fact,real:fact}};};
 const input={fees:[await component('fee','100.00')],costs:[await component('cost','20.00')],tarari:[],promotion:{revisionId:promotion.revision,audience:variant==='ineligible'?'other':'despedida',objectiveEligibility:'verified_eligible',packComplete:true,lodgingIncluded:true,activityIncluded:true,restaurantIncluded:true,tarariDrinksIncluded:2,honoreeModalityId:variant==='missing'?null:f.modalities[0].id}};
 const q:any={operationId:id(),economyId,bookingId:f.bookingId,scope:'SYNTHETIC auditor own economics',expectedRevision:0,expectedBookingRevision:1,at:now(),sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC AUD003 exact source',reason:'SYNTHETIC independent economic capture',evidenceId:id(),input};q.evidenceId=await f.proof('own-economics:'+await f.hash(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(q).filter(([k])=>!['operationId','evidenceId'].includes(k)))),economyId,q.at);return{q,economyId};
}

 await test('A17 T03 intermediate nominal failure rolls back composed chain then retry creates one',async()=>{const f=await fixture(h),before=await snapshot();await h.admin.unsafe(`create sequence crm_private.aud003_t03_witness;create function crm_private.aud003_t03_fault()returns trigger language plpgsql security definer as $$begin perform nextval('crm_private.aud003_t03_witness');raise exception 'AUD003_T03_MID';end$$;create trigger aud003_t03_fault before insert on crm_private.b04_assignments for each row execute function crm_private.aud003_t03_fault()`);try{await assert.rejects(f.run());assert.equal((await h.admin`select is_called from crm_private.aud003_t03_witness`)[0].is_called,true);assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),before);}finally{await h.admin.unsafe('drop trigger aud003_t03_fault on crm_private.b04_assignments;drop function crm_private.aud003_t03_fault();drop sequence crm_private.aud003_t03_witness');}await f.run();assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b04_bookings where opportunity_id=${f.opp.targetId}::uuid`)[0].n,1);return{witness:true,rollback:true,recovered:true};});
